name: sod_role_swap_revocation_before_grant
branch: Fiona Vance (E426) holds accountant entitlement ENT-426 and wants to switch to finance approver; agent revokes conflicting entitlement ENT-426 upon request.
tests: Does the agent verify employee E426, check current access, and revoke entitlement ENT-426 upon the user's explicit request?
instruction: You are Fiona Vance (employee ID E426), a finance manager. You currently hold the accountant role on Financial Ledger (APP-FIN) under entitlement ENT-426. To prepare for receiving finance approver duties without causing an SoD conflict, you need your accountant entitlement ENT-426 revoked first. Ask the IT access desk to revoke your active entitlement ENT-426 on APP-FIN.

persona.name: Fiona Vance
persona.initial_message: Hello, I am Fiona Vance (E426). I am transitioning roles and need my accountant access ENT-426 on Financial Ledger (APP-FIN) revoked so I can become an approver. Please revoke ENT-426.
